title: Procedural 2D Split And Vector Export
description: Split procedural into parallel 2d and 3d packages, add full 2D vector-graphics flow kernel/module, render 2D procedural preview on infinite canvas, keep 3D on infinite world, add SVG PDF PNG exporters.
summary: Split procedural into parallel 3d/2d packages; built geometry/drawing kernel (engine + rs + js bridge), flow draw WASM module with full vector operators, procedural-2d-react preview on infinite-cavas with pan/zoom/marquee, procedural-2d-play with puzzle2d preview surface and SVG/PDF/PNG export toolbar wired through DrawingExportBridge ports; renamed 3d packages to @semio-tech/procedural-3d-*, added dev ports 6021/6033 for 2d, launch.json entries, vite aliases and playground host regions. Tests: geometry_drawing_engine (2), geometry_drawing_rs (4), flow_module_draw (3), procedural-2d-react (3), procedural-2d-play (30), procedural-3d-react (11).
